scope: Exact exploratory label-permutation tests on 47 already-seen entries; not a predictive validator, not a parameter search
method: Fixed high-value-winner AUC, full exact two-sided permutation across all label assignments, p Bonferroni x4. Features selected AFTER inspecting historical medians: all findings exploratory and selection biased.
interpretation: ATR14 and 180-bar momentum features have not shown robust independent winner/loser discrimination on the already-seen MR40 cohort. Therefore do not spend more effort fitting ATR or momentum cutoffs on these 47 trades. Small losses n=6/4 mean failure to reject does not prove no predictive ability; genuinely new OOS data required.
